name: Minecraft: Ketting
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Ketting, a Minecraft Java server that runs Bukkit and Spigot plugins alongside Forge mods, for Minecraft 1.20.1 to 1.20.4. Installed by Ketting's own launcher, checked against its published checksum.
startup: read -r need most 2>/dev/null < .raptor-java || need=8; java -version 2>&1 | awk -F'"' -v need="$need" -v most="$most" '/version/ { split($2, v, "."); have = (v[1] == "1") ? v[2] : v[1]; if (have + 0 < need + 0) { printf "This Minecraft version needs Java %s or newer, and the server runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", need, have, need; exit 1 } if (most != "" && have + 0 > most + 0) { printf "This Minecraft version runs on Java %s at most, and the server runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", most, have, most; exit 1 } exit }' && exec java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 -XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true -jar {{SERVER_JAR_FILE}} -noui -nologo -daul -dau nogui

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: Ketting. Downloads Ketting's launcher (checked against its
# published checksum) and has it install Ketting for the chosen Minecraft
# version. The server then starts what was installed, without updating
# itself. Worlds, mods, plugins and settings are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
get() { curl -fsSL -A "$ua" "$1"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
# True when version $1 is $2 or older.
older_or_same() { [ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$1" "$2" | sort -V | head -n 1)" = "$1" ]; }
# Downloads $1 to $2 and checks it against $3, its published checksum
# (sha256:…, sha1:… or md5:…); a jar with none must at least be a whole
# zip. Only then is it put in place.
fetch() {
    curl -fsSL -A "$ua" -o "$2.new" "$1" || { rm -f "$2.new"; fail "The download from $1 failed. Reinstall to try again."; }
    if [ -n "${3:-}" ]; then
        if [ "$("${3%%:*}sum" "$2.new" | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "${3#*:}" ]; then
            rm -f "$2.new"
            fail "The download didn't match its published checksum. Reinstall to try again."
        fi
    elif [[ $2 == *.jar ]] && ! unzip -tq "$2.new" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        rm -f "$2.new"
        fail "The download isn't a whole jar file. Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    mv -f "$2.new" "$2"
}
# True when file $1 has the checksum $2 (as fetch takes it).
matches() { [ -f "$1" ] && [ "$("${2%%:*}sum" "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "${2#*:}" ]; }
# The Java version Minecraft $1 needs, from Mojang's version list (8 for
# versions older than the list says).
java_for() {
    local url
    url=$(get https://piston-meta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json | jq -r --arg v "$1" '.versions[] | select(.id == $v) | .url') || true
    if [ -n "$url" ]; then get "$url" | jq -r '.javaVersion.majorVersion // 8' || echo 8; else echo 8; fi
}
# Writes the Java versions the server runs on to .raptor-java, which the
# startup command checks: the oldest, and for $2 the newest, if any.
write_java() {
    echo "$1${2:+ $2}" > .raptor-java
}
# The newest Java that Forge, and the servers built on Forge or on its
# launcher, run on for Minecraft $1: 8 before 1.13 (LaunchWrapper), 11
# before 1.17 (the old ModLauncher fails on Java 16's locked-down
# internals). Nothing for newer versions.
java_most() {
    [[ $1 == 1.* ]] || return 0
    if older_or_same "$1" 1.12.2; then echo 8
    elif older_or_same "$1" 1.16.5; then echo 11; fi
}
# How to say which Java it runs on.
java_text() {
    if [ -z "${2:-}" ]; then echo "Java $1 or newer"
    elif [ "$1" = "$2" ]; then echo "Java $1 only"
    else echo "Java $1 to $2"; fi
}

jar="${SERVER_JAR_FILE:-server.jar}"
unreachable="Ketting can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
meta=$(get https://repo.kettingpowered.org/Ketting-Server-Releases/org/kettingpowered/server/forge/maven-metadata.xml) || fail "$unreachable"
# Ketting's builds are Minecraft-Forge-Ketting (1.20.1-47.4.22-0.6.1).
builds=$(grep -o '<version>[^<]*</version>' <<<"$meta" | sed -e 's/<[^>]*>//g')
newest=$(grep -o '<release>[^<]*</release>' <<<"$meta" | sed -e 's/<[^>]*>//g')
mc="${GAME_VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$mc" = latest ]; then
    mc=${newest%%-*}
else
    grep -q "^$mc-" <<<"$builds" ||
        fail "Ketting has no Minecraft $mc. Set Game version to latest, or to one of $(cut -d- -f1 <<<"$builds" | sort -uV | paste -sd, | sed 's/,/, /g')."
fi
build=$(grep "^$mc-" <<<"$builds" | sort -V | tail -n 1)

repo=https://repo.kettingpowered.org/Ketting/org/kettingpowered/kettinglauncher
launchers=$(get "$repo/maven-metadata.xml") || fail "$unreachable"
tag="${TAG_VERSION:-latest}"
tag=${tag#v}
if [ "$tag" = latest ]; then
    tag=$(grep -o '<release>[^<]*</release>' <<<"$launchers" | sed -e 's/<[^>]*>//g')
else
    grep -q "<version>$tag</version>" <<<"$launchers" ||
        fail "Ketting's launcher has no version $tag. Set Launcher version to latest, or to one of its versions."
fi
sum=$(get "$repo/$tag/kettinglauncher-$tag.jar.sha256") || fail "$unreachable"
if matches "$jar" "sha256:$sum"; then
    echo "Ketting's launcher $tag is already here."
else
    echo "Downloading Ketting's launcher $tag"
    fetch "$repo/$tag/kettinglauncher-$tag.jar" "$jar" "sha256:$sum"
fi

# The launcher installs Ketting (Forge and its libraries) for the version,
# and the server then starts whatever it installed.
echo "Installing Ketting $build. This takes a minute or two."
if ! HOME=/tmp java -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75.0 -jar "$jar" -minecraftVersion "$mc" -installOnly -noui -nologo -daul >.raptor-install.log 2>&1 ||
    ! grep -q "Successfully installed Ketting" .raptor-install.log; then
    grep -v 'Loading libs' .raptor-install.log | tail -n 20
    rm -f .raptor-install.log
    fail "Ketting's launcher couldn't install Ketting $build (its last lines are above). Reinstall to try again."
fi
rm -f .raptor-install.log
need=$(java_for "$mc")
most=$(java_most "$mc")
write_java "$need" "$most"
echo "Installed Ketting $build for Minecraft $mc. It runs on $(java_text "$need" "$most")."
